events.what: Propper (PrimeGrid) finds 107347 × 2^23427517 − 1 prime, eliminating k = 107347 and reducing the unresolved candidates below 509,203 from 42 to 41

judgement.doubts: Scope is borderline between case and bound. The bullet asks one yes/no question: is any of the remaining k < 509,203 a Riesel number? Eliminating one of 42 candidates does not settle any named part or restriction of that question. It lowers the count of live candidates, a quantity on a question that stays open, like a smallest-known-dimension record. The record's own competing_reading makes this argument and then rejects it on a literal rule. If a later pass counts each eliminated candidate as a 'case', the status would go back to partial/confirmed.

corrections.why: F3/F4: the record says the elimination is 'reducing the pool of unresolved k values below 509,203 from 42 to 41' and that 'the conjecture ... remains open'. That moves a count on an open yes/no question. It is a bound, not the settling of a restriction of the bullet. The competing_reading made this point and rejected it only on a literal rule.
F14: a progress row carries null direction. The record itself says the elimination is only 'consistent with' the conjecture, and nothing was settled.
